analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a heap buffer overflow caused by the function `agentx_parse_string`, which does not properly validate the length of the input data before copying it to a dynamically allocated buffer. This leads to a memory access violation when the data length is larger than the allocated buffer size.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The vulnerability is triggered when the `agentx_parse` function is called with a packet that contains an improperly formatted string, resulting in `agentx_parse_string` attempting to read beyond the allocated buffer size during the `memmove` operation.
